azbučnom: azbučni — alphabetical; loc. case: po azbučnom redu — in alphabetical order
biste: aux. verb conditional. mood, 2nd pers. pl.
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
deco: dete — child; voc. case, pl.: deco!
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
e: interjection; e sad — well then, so
evo: evo ga — here he is; evo nas — here we are
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
idemo: ići — to go, to ride; 1st pers. pl.
igraće: igrati — to play; future 3rd pers. sg.
izboru: izbor — choice; dat. case: po vašem izboru — of your choice
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
kasnimo: kasniti — to be late; 1st pers. pl.
kasnite: kasniti — to be late; 2nd pers. pl.
kome: koji; loc. case: u kome živim — in which I live
krećemo: kretati — to set off, to start; 1st pers. pl.
ljudi: pl. of čovek; as a form of address — «folks, guys»
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
mislim: misliti — to think; as an introductory word — «I mean, that is»
molim: moliti — to ask; molim te — please
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
navikne: navići se — to get used to; 3rd pers. sg.
nema: nemati — not to have; nema znaka — there is no sign
nisam: negation of auxiliary verba, 1st pers. sg.
niste: negation of auxiliary verba, 2nd pers. pl.
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
papir: noun masc.; toalet papir — toilet paper
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
pokazaću: pokazati — to show; future, 1st pers. sg.
popunite: popuniti — to fill in; imperative pl.
preteruje: preterivati — to overdo; 3rd pers. sg.: ne sme da se preteruje — no overdoing it
prijati: prijati — to be good for, agree with; infinitive
razmrdamo: razmrdati — to get moving, loosen up; 1st pers. pl.
računa: voditi računa — to look after, to care for
recepciji: recepcija — reception desk; loc. case: na recepciji — at the reception
redu: red — row, queue; na redu — next in line
remi: remi — rummy (card game); also a draw
sad: = sada; e sad — well then, so
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
skakanja: skakanje — jumping; gen. case: nema skakanja — no jumping
sme: smeti — to dare, to have the right; 3rd pers. sg. (ne sme — not allowed)
smete: smeti; 2nd pers. pl.: ne smete — not allowed
stoni: stoni — table (adj.): stoni tenis — table tennis
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
svakih: svaki; na svakih 200 metara — every 200 meters
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
toga: to; gen. case: biće toga još — there will be more of that
treba: trebati — to be needed; treba ti — you need
trenutak: noun masc.; trenutak istine — moment of truth
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
vas: short/full form acc. case of vi
vijuge: vijuga — convolution; acc. pl.: moždane vijuge — brain folds
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zapišite: zapisati — to write down; imperative pl.
znali: znati; past, pl.; «Erste Znali» — website name
znači: značiti — to mean; as an introductory word — «so, in short»
ćete: hteti; aux. verb future, 2nd pers. pl.
četiri: numeral; četiri i po — four and a half
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
